body.p: Each new version of includes many new features, improvements, bug fixes, and security updates. Therefore, you should always use the latest version. However, you may want to perform internal tests before allowing users to use the new features. For example, you may want to disable some of the new features to keep the UI simple or adjust some settings.
It is recommended that you deploy the new version separately on a different VM, perform acceptance tests, and then switch all users to the new deployment.

p.note: configuration (options), custom plugins, and custom frameworks are stored in Web Author's Oxygen Data Directory. If you install a new version without migrating the content from the previous data directory, the configuration will be reset to the default settings, and your plugins and frameworks will not be available in the new installation.

ol.li: Deploy the new version of on a separate virtual machine and connect it to your existing license server. The two deployments will run in parallel and use the same license pool.

Copy the relevant content from the old data directory to the new data directory so that your customizations are preserved:
Custom plugins from the user-plugins folder.
Custom frameworks from the user-frameworks folder.Only custom frameworks and plugins should be copied. Do not confuse these with the frameworks and plugins directories, which contain the built-in frameworks and plugins.
The options.xml file, which stores manually configured options.
The license.properties file, which contains the connection details for the license server.
For details about the complete contents of the data directory, see Oxygen Data Directory.

It might be necessary to update your license key. If you receive an error message about the license key version, follow this procedure. Your existing deployment will continue to work with a license for the newer version.
Review the settings on the Administration Page and confirm that your deployment-specific configuration is correct.
Switch all users to the new version. You can do this either by changing the DNS entry or by configuring the Load Balancer to use the new deployment.
